messages:
maria: Heads-up: PR #6150 shows a small tail-latency regression in the microbatch path after the last merge. can someone eyeball? https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6150 :eyes:

kevin: link looks familiar. what's the delta?

maria: on our canary (r5g-xlarge) median token-latency ~31ms -> 36ms (+16%), p95 68ms -> 95ms (+40%). throughput steady. posted raw bench below.

bench-bot: Canary run 2026-03-12T14:02Z
```
model: redwood-v2-medium
seq: 512
batch: 4
median_token_latency_ms: 36
p95_token_latency_ms: 95
throughput_rps: 120
```

ash: I think this is from the alloc tweak in commit 7a2f9c — it changed microbatch buffer alignment. Repro locally with --seq=512 and saw same pattern. I'm running a bisection.

sam: can we hold the merge for related PRs until we understand? I can approve but want a note in release notes if we keep it.

taylor: +1 hold. If bisection blames kernel selection, we might fallback to old kernel for short-term.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed: canary-2026-03-12-14:05. Health: WARN (tail latency > threshold)

ash: bisection points to 7a2f9c -> microbatch allocator change. Patch idea: restore previous alignment for batch<8. quick bench attached.

maria: thanks. can you post the bench diff? small is fine.

ash: patch branch: gh/ash/6150-fix-align. Bench on same hardware:
```
before median 36ms p95 95ms
after  median 32ms p95 72ms
```

kevin: improvement looks real. can we add a unit test to cover alignment invariants? also add a perf regression guard in PR checks.

sam: I'll add the guard and re-run canary once patch merged. anyone object to merging after tests/bench pass?

taylor: no objections. add a short mitigation note in the PR description and include which release to patch.

maria: ok i'll mark PR with 'hold-until-bench' -> removed when canary green. thanks folks :tada:

kevin: tagging infra oncall @ash for follow-up.

ash: will follow up with a smaller changelog and rollback plan.

bench-bot: canary re-run 2026-03-12T15:30Z
```
median_token_latency_ms: 32
p95_token_latency_ms: 72
throughput_rps: 118
status: PASS
```

maria: canary passed. merging after CI finishes. cheers.
